headline: EvoHarnessBench reports competence losses as agent tool, skill and specialist pools expand
summary: The v3 preprint introduces EvoHarnessBench, which tests how agent performance changes as the externally supplied pool of tools, reusable skills or specialist agents expands. Its 17 constructed streams contain 802 unique tasks derived from two verifier-based agent benchmarks. The authors report that harness expansion alone can reduce performance on previously solved tasks, with reported declines varying across the tool, skill and agent tracks; adaptation gains are also inconsistent and retention can conflict with learning new capabilities. These are paper-reported benchmark results, not independent or production measurements.
